label: Actual practice recognition of…: Recognition and correctness of a move in the distinguished actual…
definition: Recognition and correctness of a move in the distinguished actual practice, R.practice R.actual. The original CutOffReading says no outsider-shared move of that practice is correct. It does not describe capability in other candidate situations.
note: This analyst scope distinguishes actual uptake from possible recognizable revelation. ActualAdmissible and CutOffPersistsToAdmissible explicitly govern any move to admitted nonactual situations; neither follows from the word religious. No source claim is reinterpreted. ActualPracticeRecognition σ R g m encodes precisely RecognizesAsDivine R.actual g m AND (R.practice R.actual).Correct m for the same move and unrestricted candidate g. Correct means grammatical correctness in Practice, not independently calibrated truth. Recognition remains the existing primitive judgment of divine origin; external-sign capability, Godhood, shared reason and reality calibration are not added. The Boolean uptake controls are test interpretations only, not restrictions of the original carrier.
